name: Gasket
description: A gasket blank: the sealing face with its bore and a ring of bolt holes punched round it.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 4%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 42%, #000 42%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 42%, #000 42%); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 42%, #000 42%), radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, transparent 12%, #000 12%) 0 0 / 25% 25%; mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 42%, #000 42%), radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, transparent 12%, #000 12%) 0 0 / 25% 25%; -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
